native_dependency.experimental_upstream_status: Prototype; not production-ready upstream. This patch leaves the feature definition and check unchanged. Production activation requires separate engine review and native acceptance.

main_api.create: webContents.createOwnedGuest({session,...safePreferences,initialSurfaceSize:{width,height}}) -> the single owned WebContents; exact positive integer DIP dimensions <=2147483647 and explicit Session required. Kind calls after authorized create admission, before first loadURL; no implicit engine dimensions.
main_api.lease: guest.createOwnedGuestLease(embedderWebContents, genuineFrameToken, generation) -> single-use token or empty string; generation must be exact integer1..2147483647 and strictly increase; bound live embedder primary RFH and destination FrameTreeNodeId; expires at60s
main_api.cancel: guest.cancelOwnedGuestLease(token) -> boolean; always retains page. Prior presentation remains until native transfer detaches; interrupted transfer may leave retained page without presentation.
main_api.release: guest.releaseOwnedGuest(generation) -> boolean; exact generation, preserves contents/Session/debugger
main_api.visibility: guest.setOwnedGuestVisibility(generation, visible) -> boolean; actual window visibility narrows requested visibility; no focus
main_api.close: guest.destroy(); revokes pending leases, releases presentation/capturer and deletes owned contents exactly once
main_api.popup: owned opener AddNewContents wraps SAME native popup in SAME BrowserContext, preserving its positive actual unscaled widget/container size; otherwise uses immutable initialSurfaceSize explicitly supplied by kind to opener. Host registers options.webContents and returns it; outlivesOpener explicit.
main_api.private_gvm: findOwnedGuestLease + attachOwnedGuest validate/commit callbacks exist only in main linked binding; not renderer control APIs

renderer_api.prepare: connected empty <webview>.getOwnedGuestFrameToken(); main independently binds the returned genuine native frame after resolving current authorized surface
renderer_api.attach: element.adoptOwnedGuest(token,generation) -> Promise<void>; no URL/Session/new page; binding UUID and per-element epoch reject stale completion/release
renderer_api.release: element.releaseOwnedGuest(); DOM disconnection releases presentation only
renderer_api.focus: element.focus() uses existing native embedded iframe focus; model CDP focus emulation remains independent
renderer_api.geometry: ordinary embedded WebContents DOM clipping/transforms; full page rect separate from outer clip; model emulated metrics remain kind/CDP-owned

build_contract.checkout: Exact Chromium+Electron commits; apply the canonical Electron patch series for that release before compiling.
build_contract.artifact: separate Octopus-owned macOS Electron app/framework with complete source, official patch-series and toolchain hashes; never replace an existing bundle from this helper
build_contract.native_acceptance_scope: Authored same-WC transfer, popup, frame/lease cancellation, pre-DOM no-explicit-emulation two changed pixel captures, same page after detach, and retained emulation. Not executed. Authored same-WC renderer crash + diagnostic actual document/history replacement; not executed.
commands_compile_patched_sources_only: gn gen out/OwnedGuest --args='import("//electron/build/args/release.gn") target_os="mac" target_cpu="arm64" enable_owned_guest_embedder=true electron_vendor_version="octopus_owned_guest:1"'
build_contract.availability_blocker: Foundation alone preserves disabled upstream feature. Production variant source replaces global activation with the exact owned-wrapper native callback; complete release-series source composition and native compilation/acceptance remain unproved. Package selector requires their actual receipts.

initial_surface.native_initialization: public content::WebContents.Resize on owned unattached native container before factory returns/first loadURL
initial_surface.detach: capture actual positive unscaled view size before retained detach; recreate root through unchanged GuestContentsHandle chain; restore container only alive+same owner+unattached, preserve Chromium-selected positive replacement widget size after container autoresize
initial_surface.model_metrics: No Emulation command/default or GetSizeForNewRenderView override added. Nullable host modelViewport is independent. Existing actual emulation widget size retains priority.
initial_surface.paint_acceptance: Unproved; authored native spec only, no native execution

diagnostic_history.scope: Main-owned diagnostic document replaces actual failed entry in the SAME WebContents. No URL/model action recreation or replay.
diagnostic_history.native_spec: retains the crashed WebContents and replaces only its diagnostic history entry

production_variant.activation: explicit GN enable_owned_guest_embedder=true; Chromium default feature unchanged; exact owned native wrapper callback only
